main-carousel-desc: We are a non-profit organization that aids and assists Filipino communities in poverty. Our goal is to provide Filipinos with different opportunities that can help alleviate their living conditions.
main-our-mission-desc: To empower communities and develop holistic minded leaders through programs that will help the poor overcome poverty and develop people’s values, skills and leadership potentials.
main-our-vision-desc: Communities of people living purposeful and productive lives with integrity, and genuinely caring for others and their environment.
main-our-beneficiaries-bgl: We envision Batang Gift of Love to be role models of their communities. We hope that all children will have the capacity to finish their education and achieve financial stability in the future.
main-our-beneficiaries-lm: We make handcrafted products, such as paper quilling products, recycled wallets, and other sustainable products. Through the creation of these products, we aim to preserve the essence or culture.
main-our-beneficiaries-ggs: We are dedicated in uplifting the lives of vulnerable children by supporting their physical, education, and spiritual needs through our various programs.

aboutus-history-desc: (CHAI) is a non-stock, non-profit organization that assists poor Filipinos by bringing various opportunities that can help them improve their living conditions. Established in January 2008, it has targeted poverty issues including access to good quality education, livelihood, improved health and nutrition, and responsible harnessing and utilization of natural resources. CHAI greatly believes in empowering the people through capacity building for a more sustainable development and values the ideas and concerns of all stakeholders. It believes in character development as a significant tool in bringing forth justice, equality, and transparency among communities effecting improvement of the quality of life.
aboutus-sdg-desc: "Turning vision into action through sustainable development."
aboutus-sdg-2: Through our livelihood initiatives, we envision empowered communities capable of sustaining their own needs and improving the quality of life.
aboutus-sdg-4: Believing in education as the foundation of growth, we aim to cultivate learners who are equipped with the skills, values, and confidence to shape a better future.
aboutus-sdg-ending: At CHAI-Taguig, we work towards a world wherein no individual gets left behind. Together, we are guided by our commitment to serve and build communities of hope, learning, and opportunity for all women and children.

aboutus-officers-desc: At CHAI-Taguig, we work together to uplift women and children by spreading compassion, hope, and opportunities to those in need.
aboutus-aboutus-desc: CHAI-Taguig is a community organization located in Maharlika Village, Taguig, Metro Manila. We are committed to uplifting lives through education, livelihood programs, and sustainable initiatives that inspire positive change and empower local communities.

gg-mission-body: To transform the lives of the most vulnerable children by meeting their physical, spiritual, educational, and psychosocial needs through various programs.
